association_rule: A person associated with one or more Businesses uses the contextually relevant Business Reputation; unrelated scores are never averaged.
rules: This template creates no Business, Reputation score, economy, Incorporation, event, funds, fleet, or campaign-specific state in RHC canon.
Create a separately named configuration file before activating a Reputation mechanic for a specific Business.
Reputation is a default public/institutional standing input only; it never becomes NPC obedience, relationships, knowledge, invitations, or spawned NPCs.
Positive gains above the high_standing.threshold use positive_gain_multiplier with floor rounding; negative changes are never reduced by that asymmetry.
Classification follows established scope/consequence, never a desired final score.
A later owner persists the returned result; this primitive performs no persistence, Begin Day integration, RNG, or Business economy resolution.
